# Walk-forward evaluation, 2024-01-01 to 2025-06-24 (generated by `scripts/run_walk_forward.py`)

Quarterly retraining with the frozen hyper-parameters of each horizon (see the script docstring). MAE in MW, mean of the 3 seeds' predictions. **Windows marked * (2024-Q1, 2024-Q2) lie in the validation period on which the hyper-parameters were tuned and are not independent. Windows from 2024-Q3 overlap the test period** and are an additional, exploratory view of it; nothing is selected from these results.

## Horizon 1 h

| window | train / eval samples | best naive | ridge | XGBoost S4 | LSTM L4 | LSTM equal budget | XGBoost minus ridge | LSTM L4 minus XGBoost |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2024-Q1* | 19,887 / 2,184 | 4,513 | 1,019 | 1,022 | 1,467 | 1,413 | +2 | +445 |
| 2024-Q2* | 22,071 / 2,183 | 3,755 | 1,154 | 1,207 | 1,644 | 1,510 | +53 | +437 |
| 2024-Q3 | 24,254 / 2,207 | 3,097 | 975 | 954 | 1,247 | 1,234 | -22 | +294 |
| 2024-Q4 | 26,461 / 2,208 | 4,551 | 890 | 829 | 1,168 | 1,251 | -61 | +339 |
| 2025-Q1 | 28,669 / 2,157 | 5,323 | 1,126 | 1,348 | 1,331 | 1,425 | +223 | -18 |
| 2025-Q2 | 30,826 / 2,039 | 3,583 | 1,175 | 1,224 | 1,408 | 1,465 | +49 | +184 |
| mean of windows from 2024-Q3 | | 4,138 | 1,041 | 1,089 | 1,288 | 1,344 | +47 | +200 |

XGBoost was better than ridge in 2 of 6 windows; the LSTM L4 was better than XGBoost in 1 of 6 windows.
